The quickest way to get your hands on one is to visit the Advertisement page, there are always sweet deals to be made with the members. You'll find: selling of genos (from tundra to brown!), Rites of Fertility in exchange for a litter, even art deals that go from giving you one pup to a full litter.
If you're short on having points, TokoCamp can help you get your first tokota/geno!

The other ways to get your hands on a toko is to wait for raffles, giveaways and events that are posted by the group, :devtok 
You can find design info here

9153: The Dam is an EE black, and the Sire is a Tt tundra; shouldn't they all be black?
EE black bred to a tundra still only has a small chance of passing black as the coat color unfortunately. Even though it's dominant, it won't always bring blacks ;-;/
When was that rule passed? Last time I bred an EE black to a Tt tundra the Dom EE passed as a Dom trait.

It isn't a rule at all, it's always been that way ^^ We have a coded roller that contains all the specs for inputting our breedings. Based on the coding and the genos between the two parents as well as other factors such as items/companions, it rolls a random amount of pups and uses the genos of the two parents to create the puppies genotypes (more common ones show up more often, and rarer ones show up less often). It's just one of those you may get lucky, you may not sort of things.

It's just best to breed blacks with Aa browns or other blacks if you really want black puppies since they have the highest chances ;-;

Blac k is rolled as a mutation of sorts, even if you have an EE tokota, and breed it to an Aa or Tt, you won't always get black. Its a small percentage chance - making black the most rare of base coats. If you had a breeding that resulted in all blacks you are extremely lucky, but it has always been this way, nothing has changed. Also please note the group if you have questions next time, no other comments beside litters and owner transfers should be here.

[Tokotines 2020] Mauja + Ciro Mauja stared down at her shifting paws, using her bear-like claws to leave nonsense lines and marks in the shallow snow. Butterflies fluttered in her stomach, threatening to come up her throat and spill out into the scenic sunset taking place. Nervous, why was she so nervous? the slate roan piebald closed her eyes and took a deep, soothing breath and held it for a moment. She felt a small hand reaching into her thickly furred neck to offer a comforting pat. Mauja opened her eyes and released her breath, producing a wisp of smoke from her mouth that dissipated in the cold air. Mauja turned towards her handler, Kit, and leaned into the comforting physical touch. Together they watched as the sun slowly, oh so slowly, continued on the path down the sky. The sun painted the landscape with a tinge of pink and orange, creating a romantic atmosphere. Oh, no. More butterflies... why did she ever agree to this anyways? It was out of character for her, finding a mate was not anywhere near the top of her list of priorities. And yet... here she was.--It was an understatement to say Kit was quite excited when she discovered kindling, a Tokota dating app. Mauja had never heard of anything more ridiculous, but could only stand by as her handler's exhilaration snowballed as she snapped a few flattering pictures of the dark pied female and inputted her information. "Hmm, now all we need is a catchy tag line," Kit mused, rubbing her chin. "Hmm... got it. 'Let's Tokobout Us'!" the girl began to giggle uncontrollably as she submitted the kindling profile.Mauja cringed. Oh dear Aippaq. Puns. Not even a good one. Could this get any more embarrassing?"Come on, let's take a look at the eligible bachelors, shall we?" Kit waggled her eyebrows.As they began to swipe, Kit suddenly had to acknowledge that it was not normal in the slightest to be helping your bear-dog peruse potential mates on an app, pausing to see if they found the beast on the screen attractive enough. Fortunately, or not so fortunately, every single profile was met with an unimpressed grunt or eye roll and, thus, a swipe left. "Mauja, we've been at this for almost fifteen minutes," Kit groaned. Her thumb was tired. "You have to like someone!"The slate roan piebald only sniffed in response, although she didn't walk away. A good sign she was now invested in the task of swiping. They continued on, until finally a white paw was gently, hesitantly placed on Kit's arm to signal the girl to stop. Mauja's eyes studied the profile up and down and finally gave a small nod. Ciro was the bachelor's name.Unable to conceal her victory grin, Kit paused dramatically before delivering their first swipe right.It was a match!--Mauja blushed as the greying tundra piebald slowly stepped forward from the bushes, seemingly just as nervous and shy as the darker pied was. Ciro paused and looked back over his shoulder, as if someone still hidden in the underbrush was pushing him onward with their encouragement. With a slight nod, the male continued to approach. In Ciro's maw was a beautiful flower, a single coral colored rose that was still glistening with dew in the sun's last rays of light. Shyly looking down, Ciro approached and then drew courage to gaze in Mauja's lavender eyes, extending the rose as an offering to his date and her handler."Oh, how sweet!" Kit exclaimed, swooning as she gently accepted the token on her tokota's behalf and tucked it behind Mauja's ear.Eyelashes fluttering, Mauja stepped forward and gave Ciro a small lick on the cheek as a gesture of appreciation, causing them both butterflies. With one final look at Kit, the duo trotted off to a more private area to get to know each other better -- a night spent looking at the stars.
